Pass multiple Tesseract language codes as a list

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extract
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="image/png", uri="https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json('{"ocr":{"backend":"tesseract","enabled":true,"language":["eng","deu","fra"]}}')
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
